title: CALM View (POC draft — NOT a standard)
description: Draft meta-schema for a CALM view: a named, audience-tagged selection over one architecture. Filter only — no presentation properties (layout, pins, colors, themes are out of scope by design; see finos/architecture-as-code#3552). POC for finos/architecture-as-code#2344. Provisional pending #3624 (reference format). suggested-formats is a non-normative hint only: any renderer may ignore it.

$schema.description: Reference to this meta-schema (convention; also lets content detectors route by keyword).

description.description: What question this view answers, and for whom.

audience.description: Stakeholder roles this view serves (cf. ISO 42010 stakeholder). Free strings; no LDAP mapping (future work).

suggested-formats.description: Non-normative presentation hint for this view's readers (e.g. svg for managers, json for developers, markdown as compliance record). Renderers may ignore it; renderer-neutrality holds.

derived-from.description: Provenance for derived views (frozen snapshot, re-derivable). Absent on hand-authored views. Carries no intent: intent lives in custom views only.

for.description: One-way reference to the architecture this view selects from. Provisional semantics: path relative to this file's directory (pending finos/architecture-as-code#3624).

filter.description: Inclusion selectors. A node is in the view if its unique-id is listed in 'nodes' or its node-type is listed in 'node-types'. A relationship is in the view if listed in 'relationships', or if all its endpoints are in the view (closure). Flows and decorators resolve by unique-id against sibling documents.
